{{Quote|Is this channel secure? Look, I'm trying to get out of this whole Separatist business, but they have&hellip; information&hellip; on me.|The defector|<ref name="Encounter" />}}
A '''defector''' was a former member of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="Encounter" /> in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Inside Job|Ord Mantell}}</ref> Attempting to leave the movement, the defector made contact with an individual over an open channel, seeking help to destroy data held by the Mantellian separatists. The defector revealed the location of a [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth generator]] dropped outside the [[Separatist stronghold]], a fortress operated by the movement in [[Mount Avilatan]] on Ord Mantell.<ref name="Encounter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Separatist defector first appeared in the dynamic encounter mission "Inside Job," introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
